Prompt-level happiness and anger ratings from an experience-sampling study

Source: R/data.R
ema_beeps.Rd

ema_beeps is a dataset of all 11,474 answered prompts ("beeps") from a 14-day experience-sampling study of 321 university students (Neubauer & Schmiedek, 2024). Each row is one prompt with the participant, the study day, the time of the prompt and the ratings of happiness and anger, rescaled from 1-7 to 1-5 by round(1 + (x - 1) * 4 / 6). Participants answered between 1 and 69 prompts; the 14 study days of one participant need not be consecutive calendar days.

The data are in long format. With the var, day and timestamp arguments of survey_snake() each study day becomes a band and each rating is placed at its time of day; the prompt times of one participant can be shown with activity_snake().

Usage

ema_beeps

Format

A data frame with 11,474 rows (prompts) and 5 columns:

id

Character. Anonymised participant identifier.

day

Integer 1-14. Study day.

start_time

POSIXct (UTC). Time of the prompt, between April and July 2021.

happy

Integer 1-5. Rated happiness.

angry

Integer 1-5. Rated anger.

Source

Neubauer, A. B., & Schmiedek, F. (2024). Approaching academic adjustment on multiple time scales. Zeitschrift fuer Erziehungswissenschaft, 27(1), 147–168. doi:10.1007/s11618-023-01182-8

Data: https://osf.io/bhq3p | Codebook: https://osf.io/csfwg | Code: https://osf.io/84kdr/files | License: CC-BY 4.0

See also

ema_emotions and student_survey for person-level ratings; survey_snake(); activity_snake().

Examples

# Anger over the 14 study days, each rating at its time of day
survey_snake(ema_beeps, var = "angry", day = "day",
             timestamp = "start_time")


# Happiness per study day as stacked bars
survey_snake(ema_beeps, var = "happy", day = "day", tick_shape = "bar")


# When one participant answered the prompts
activity_snake(subset(ema_beeps, id == "xcVDLRQOwn", select = start_time),
               show_total = FALSE, show_count = TRUE)
